<title level="1" right="Condition">[Dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 442

Your eyes are overstimulated or your vision is swimming. If vision is your only [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411), all creatures and objects are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) from you.
